definitionAudit.name: Domain
definitionAudit.detail: Exactly set plus nonempty, closed, convex. No hidden regularity bundle or proof ingredient.

definitionAudit.name: project
definitionAudit.detail: Chooses an existing nearest point using exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex; no fallback/default branch. project_spec gives membership and exact infimal distance; project_existsUnique gives complete characterization and uniqueness. Their proof bodies/compilation were not inspected, so producer proof correctness is not certified.

definitionAudit.name: advance
definitionAudit.detail: P_V(x-eta*g), defined all eta. For eta>0, advance_proximal_minimizer is its affine/quadratic source minimizer bridge. It does not define the general source argmin.

definitionAudit.name: iterate
definitionAudit.detail: Zero-based recursion with fixed eta and supplied g. No source repair or hidden premise.

definitionAudit.name: prediction
definitionAudit.detail: iterate(t+1), post-current-vector state; exact index map in statement-map.

definitionAudit.name: regret
definitionAudit.detail: Sum over range T of affine-loss differences at prediction t against fixed u. Definition extends to infeasible u, while source-bound comparator is feasible.

successorReason: Independently reviewed the exact extraction-v2 successor. Frozen Lean signatures and semantic/binder findings unchanged; v1 review and source evidence retained.
